title: Messages (iMessage) data
whyItMatters: Messages stores conversations, attachments and contact details. Who the user spoke to and what was shared is visible from this folder alone.
notes: TCC-protected (Messages data): a live scan needs Full Disk Access; root alone is not enough. chat.db and attachments are never opened.

cleanup.exportFirst: Save or print the conversations you need from the Messages window, because the attachments and history go with the folder.
cleanup.signOut: In Messages open Settings > iMessage and sign out of the Apple Account, then turn Messages off in iCloud.
steps: Quit Messages so its database is not in use.
Delete the Messages folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Every conversation, attachment and contact detail kept by Messages leaves this Mac. iCloud copies stay in the account.
